name: swainwong-whiteboard-video-plugin
description: Create mature whiteboard explainer videos with eleven source-backed animation recipes, calibrated hands, narration budgets and executable input contracts.

interface.shortDescription: 白板手绘讲解视频：11种动画、素材合同与运行检查
interface.longDescription: Produce editable whiteboard explainers using mature illustrations, real-looking hand assets, ordered paths, finished-image placement and vertical completed-stage overviews. Includes local Remotion templates and validation; does not claim automatic image-to-stroke conversion or audiovisual acceptance.
defaultPrompt: 使用白板手绘视频插件，根据我的文稿和图片准备素材、选择动画、检查输入并渲染可编辑视频。
